description: This Java source file is a Spring configuration class, DataInitializer, that seeds initial customer data into an in-memory H2 database at application startup. It defines a Bean implementing CommandLineRunner to insert sample Customer entities with associated Address and Contact details if the repository is empty.

classes.name: DataInitializer
classes.description: Spring configuration class that initializes sample customer data into the database at startup.

methods.name: seedData
methods.description: Bean method returning a CommandLineRunner that inserts sample Customer data into the repository if it is empty.
